title: Memory (sub-region of predication-graph store for recall records)
description: Per lab/.../predicated-agentic-orchestration-platform/memory/memory.md: the platform's pattern for recording what an agent has recently encountered. A sub-region of the predication-graph store whose entities are recall records. Three properties: relevance-is-a-value (bilattice-valued, not Boolean), settled-by-closure-rules (relevance-decay/recency-promotion/explicit-dismissal each are closure rules), capped-by-scope (bounded by agent's scope). Context-engineering concerns (window size, compaction, retrieval-augmented prompts) are particular realizations under specific cost constraints.

relevance.description: Presence strength. A value corner (legacy bilattice path) OR a Q value in [0,1] (Q-enriched path; hacking/q-relevance, docs/GENEALOGY.md §6).
